canonical.label: Canonical
canonical.description: Books recognized by the Catholic Church (Old and New Testament, 73 books)

deuterocanonical.label: Deuterocanonical
deuterocanonical.description: Books recognized by Catholic/Orthodox churches (Tobit, Judith, 1-2 Maccabees, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch)

apocryphal.label: Apocryphal
apocryphal.description: Books NOT recognized by the Catholic Church. Labeled but not available for download in Ora.
